feature.body: An area play mapping Kincora’s full project portfolio across the Macquarie Arc and Cobar Basin systems, colour-coded by metal endowment and set against district anchors — Cadia, Northparkes, Cowal — plus partnered ground. It turns a scattered land package into a single, legible story.

feature.body: A regional locator placing NGEX’s Los Helados inside the Vicuña District — flanked by the Maricunga and El Indio porphyry belts and the names the market knows: Caserones, Cerro Casale, and the BHP / Lundin Vicuña project. Borders, infrastructure, and scale all read at a glance.
